editorial:
Imagine being so desperate to get your ex back that you decide to bring your dead bandmates back from the grave using black magic. That is exactly where you find yourself with Brodie. He is just a guy who loves heavy metal and wants to win a battle-of-the-bands to impress Medina. The vibe here is totally wild and loud, mixing gross-out gore with jokes that land perfectly. It feels like a giant party where everything goes wrong in the funniest way possible. You get to see Brodie struggle with his resurrected friends, Zakk and Dion, who are not exactly the same helpful buddies they were before they died.

What really works here is the fast energy and the crazy practical effects that make the blood and guts look real. The acting is spot on, and the pacing never slows down, though some of the plot twists are a bit silly. If you love movies that do not take themselves seriously, you will have a blast. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the messy details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of the first one, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Brodie realizes that the only way to stop the chaos is to use a special metal riff to send his friends back to hell. After a huge, bloody fight, he successfully banishes Zakk and Dion. He does not get Medina back in the end, but he finds peace with his music. The twist is that the demon they summoned is still lurking, hinting that the horror is not truly over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gore and loud music.
